Voice & software credits

wasmtts v2.6.0

wasmtts contributors, 2026. MIT licence. Released engine files are unchanged. Our separate worker adapter assembles verified file parts for static hosting. The frontend includes a Taiwan Mandarin pronunciation profile, with explicit overrides for the trial's tone and polyphonic-word comparisons.

Speech models

Matcha Chinese/English model by dengcunqin: original model and Vocos resource collection. The model's pinned README declares Apache License 2.0: retained model card, licence text. Vocos ONNX bytes are distributed through sherpa-onnx. No claim is made that the voice has passed independent Mandarin-teacher review.

Browser runtime

Microsoft ONNX Runtime Web 1.27.0: MIT licence. kaldifst/OpenFST are included in the released normalizer WASM; Apache 2.0. The engine uses lamejs/LAME for its MP3 warm-up: upstream licence notice, LGPL licence, LAME project. The separate library is unmodified and can be replaced. Trial output uses PCM WAV.

Human references

The four reference syllables are recordings by Chen Wang (王琛). See the app's human recording credits.

The article is original Hanzi Path content. All voice assets are served from this app. No text is sent to a speech API. Pinned sources, byte lengths and integrity hashes.
